description: Intent i005 (branch rtnl-doit-attr-gaps, snapshot s01) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): net/mpls/af_mpls.c:2114-2122, mpls_valid_fib_dump_req() in the '#else' (CONFIG_INET=n) branch of the #if at line 2073. The handler parses RTM_GETROUTE dump-request attributes with nlmsg_parse_deprecated_strict() into tb[], then loops over all attribute indices and in the 'if (i == RTA_OIF)' arm dereferences tb[i] via nla_get_u32() with NO tb[RTA_OIF] NULL check — while the sibling 'else if (tb[i])' arm of the same loop proves NULL slots are expected. A dump request omitting RTA_OIF leaves tb[RTA_OIF]==NULL and nla_get_u32(NULL) is a near-NULL read/oops. Reachability: rtnetlink_rcv_msg() (net/core/rtnetlink.c:5325) applies no CAP_NET_ADMIN to dump requests; the handler is registered as dumpit via rtnl_register_module(PF_MPLS, RTM_GETROUTE, NULL, mpls_dump_route) at af_mpls.c:2747 and invoked from mpls_dump_route() when cb->strict_check (NETLINK_GET_STRICT_CHK, settable unprivileged) — line ~2170. This matches the seed mechanism: netlink attribute-slot presence not validated before the slot is dereferenced. Counterevidence: with CONFIG_INET=y the #if branch delegates to ip_valid_fib_dump_req() (net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:889) whose loop correctly does 'if (!tb[i]) continue;', so the bug exists only in MPLS-without-INET builds; no .config is present in the snapshot and no build was possible, hence medium confidence. Negative evidence (all classified safe with exact guards verified): rtnl_bridge_setlink/dellink memcpy(nla_data(attr)) guarded by have_flags set only when attr assigned (rtnetlink.c:4792); tc_ctl_action TCA_ACT_TAB check; phonet RTA_DST/RTA_OIF OR-guard (pn_netlink.c:248); qrtr IFA_LOCAL check; rtnl_net_newid; fib_nl2rule FRA_* guards; devinet rtm_to_ifaddr/inet_rtm_deladdr; br_setlink/br_setport/br_afspec; dcb_doit and nested DCB setters; can gw cgw_parse_attr; tc_new_tfilter/tc_del_tfilter/tc_ctl_tclass. Limitations: per-kind rtnl_link_ops newlink/changelink callbacks only spot-checked; ipv6 addrconf/route, nexthop, ipmr/ip6mr, decnet, and per-filter/qdisc-kind change()/init() callbacks scanned but not read function-by-function.
